Game on the sports feed this cycle: Oaks at KONO — The Oaks put the Orlando Magic away in the first quarter and made it three straight, Oaks 125 - Magic 109, in front of a 94% crowd at home. Oakland scored 41 in the opening quarter to lead 41-27, went up 73-52 at the half and 101-76 after three, and the Magic only got it respectable by winning a garbage-time fourth 33-24. Adash Stanley led with 24 points, 8 assists and zero turnovers, hitting 6 of 12 from three. AJ Dybantsa bounced back from his 4 for 15 night against Oklahoma City by going 11 of 13 for 23 points, and Dillon Brooks followed his 22-point Cup opener with 23 on 10 of 14, giving him back-to-back 20-point games. Austin Reaves scored all 15 of his points from deep, 5 of 10 from three, with 7 assists, and Wendell Carter Jr. added 12 on 6 of 10. Off the bench T. Jerome had 9 points and 7 assists in 18 minutes and J. Valančiūnas went 4 for 5 for 8. Harry Hayward played 16 minutes after his 23 in Toronto and filled the line with 5 points, 2 steals and a block. As a team the Oaks shot 53 of 89, 18 of 33 from three, with 33 assists against only 4 turnovers, and went to the line just once all night. B. Simmons, who scored 5 in Toronto, was a DNP along with B. James Jr., J. Tate and Coen Carr. The Oaks move to 7-1. (the rider lift is real only where a station row says "game day")

Game on the sports feed this cycle: Oaks at San Antonio — The Oaks went into a sold-out Philadelphia, lost a 14-point lead, and won it back with the best fourth quarter of their young season, Oaks 120 - 76ers 106. Oakland opened 31-17, but the 76ers poured in 36 in the second to cut it to 56-53 at the half and won the third 29-24 to lead 82-80 going into the fourth. Then the Oaks scored 40 and held Philadelphia to 24, turning a two-point deficit into a 14-point win. AJ Dybantsa led with 25 on 10 of 16 and a perfect 3 for 3 from deep, following up his 11 of 13 night against Orlando. Adash Stanley added 23 on 8 of 13, 5 of 7 from three, with 7 assists. The story was Harry Hayward. After 16 minutes against Orlando, the second-round rookie played 22 and scored a career-high 19 on 9 of 15 with 7 rebounds and 2 blocks, topping his 12-point night in Detroit. Wendell Carter Jr. pulled down 15 rebounds, 3 of them offensive, with 12 points on 6 of 9, and T. Jerome ran the second unit with 9 assists in 22 minutes. J. Champagnie, scoreless against Orlando, hit 3 of 5 from three for 9 in 16 minutes. Austin Reaves had an off night, 4 of 14 in a team-high 41 minutes. B. Simmons was a DNP for the third straight game, his only minutes in the last five coming in the Toronto blowout, and B. James Jr., J. Tate and Coen Carr sat again. The Oaks shot 48 of 88 and 15 of 28 from three, but turned it over 14 times, after just 4 against Orlando. The Oaks win their fourth straight and move to 8-1. (the rider lift is real only where a station row says "game day")
